name: vwap_breakout_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus
thesis: VWAP serves as the single most important intraday level for institutional traders. Unlike strategy 3 (VWAP cross momentum, which trades the first cross), this strategy specifically targets the DECISIVE break of VWAP that occurs after price has tested VWAP 3+ times and finally breaks through with conviction. Multiple tests of VWAP weaken the opposing side's limit orders (like a battering ram), and the eventual breakthrough triggers a cascade of stops and new momentum entries. The edge exists because the 3+ test requirement is highly selective — most VWAP strategies trade the first cross (noisy) while this waits for the high-conviction multi-test break. The inefficiency persists because counting VWAP tests and measuring breakout conviction in real-time is computationally specific.
stock_filter: ADV(20) > 50 crore INR AND close > 100 INR

indicators.name: vwap_touch_count
indicators.params: count of bars where abs(close - VWAP) / VWAP < 0.05% in session

indicators.name: side_before_break
indicators.params: mode of sign(close - VWAP) over last 20 bars

conditions: close > VWAP * 1.001 (clear break above VWAP by > 0.1%)
vwap_touch_count >= 3 (VWAP has been tested 3+ times today)
side_before_break == -1 (price was predominantly below VWAP before the break)
long.confirmation: 2 consecutive bars closing above VWAP after the 3rd+ test

conditions: close < VWAP * 0.999 (clear break below VWAP by > 0.1%)
side_before_break == 1 (price was predominantly above VWAP before the break)
short.confirmation: 2 consecutive bars closing below VWAP after the 3rd+ test

entry.entry_price: market order on 2nd confirmation bar close

exit.target: 0.5% from entry (once VWAP is decisively broken, follow-through tends to be significant)
exit.stop_loss: VWAP (if price crosses back through VWAP, the break has failed)
exit.signal_exit: exit if price closes within 0.05% of VWAP for 2 bars (reversion to the line)

filters.time_filter: no entries before 10:00 (need multiple VWAP tests to occur) or after 14:30
filters.trend_filter: prefer breaks in direction of NIFTY 50 trend
other_filters: vwap_touch_count must be >= 3 — this is the core filter distinguishing from basic VWAP cross strategies

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — multi-test VWAP break is a specific setup; counting touches is not standard

weaknesses: The 3+ touch requirement is strict — many valid VWAP breaks occur on the first or second test
Defining a 'touch' (within 0.05% of VWAP) is arbitrary; different thresholds produce different touch counts
Late-session VWAP breaks (after 13:00) have insufficient time to develop — limited by flatten time
prior_art: VWAP as a key institutional level is standard (Brian Shannon, SMB Capital). The 'multiple test then break' concept is from support/resistance theory (Al Brooks). Combining these — counting VWAP touches before trading the break — is a practical synthesis that is less commonly formalized in published strategies.
notes: Edge math: 0.55 * 50bps - 0.45 * 33bps = 27.5 - 14.9 = 12.6 bps gross. Costs ~11 bps. Net ≈ 1.6 bps per trade. Marginally positive. The strategy's strength is in high selectivity — only taking the highest-conviction VWAP breaks. Low frequency (0-2/day) limits absolute P&L but keeps quality high.
